parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const headers=Object.fromEntries(Object.entries($json.headers||{}).map(([k,v])=>[k.toLowerCase(),String(v)]));const id=headers['svix-id'],timestamp=headers['svix-timestamp'],signature=headers['svix-signature'];if(!id||!timestamp||!signature)throw new Error('Missing required Svix headers');const raw=$json.rawBody;if(typeof raw!=='string'&&!(raw instanceof Buffer))throw new Error('Exact raw webhook body is required');const ts=Number(timestamp);if(!Number.isFinite(ts)||Math.abs(Date.now()/1000-ts)>300)throw new Error('Webhook timestamp outside allowed window');const secret=String($env.AGENTMAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET||'');if(!secret.startsWith('whsec_'))throw new Error('AgentMail webhook secret is not configured');const key=Buffer.from(secret.slice(6),'base64');const payload=`${id}.${timestamp}.${Buffer.isBuffer(raw)?raw.toString('utf8'):raw}`;const expected=crypto.createHmac('sha256',key).update(payload).digest();const candidates=signature.split(/\s+/).map(part=>part.split(',')).filter(parts=>parts[0]==='v1'&&parts[1]).map(parts=>{try{return Buffer.from(parts[1],'base64')}catch{return Buffer.alloc(0)}});const verified=candidates.some(candidate=>candidate.length===expected.length&&crypto.timingSafeEqual(candidate,expected));if(!verified)throw new Error('Invalid AgentMail webhook signature');const body=$json.body&&typeof $json.body==='object'?$json.body:JSON.parse(Buffer.isBuffer(raw)?raw.toString('utf8'):raw);return [{json:{headers,body,svix_id:id,signature_verified:true,raw_body:Buffer.isBuffer(raw)?raw.toString('utf8'):raw}}];

const p=$json.body||{};if(p.event_type!=='message.received')return [{json:{accepted:true,ignored:true,event_type:p.event_type||'unknown',event_id:p.event_id||$json.svix_id}}];const m=p.message||p.data||{};const inboxId=m.inbox_id||p.inbox_id;const threadId=m.thread_id||p.thread_id;const messageId=m.message_id||p.message_id;const eventId=p.event_id||$json.svix_id;const timestamp=m.timestamp||m.received_timestamp||p.timestamp||new Date().toISOString();if(!inboxId||!threadId||!messageId||!eventId)throw new Error('Inbound payload missing inbox_id, thread_id, message_id, or event_id');const text=String(m.extracted_text||m.text||'').slice(0,100000);const sender=m.from||m.sender||null;const recipients=m.to||m.recipients||[];const attachments=Array.isArray(m.attachments)?m.attachments.map(a=>({attachment_id:a.attachment_id,filename:a.filename,size:a.size,content_type:a.content_type})):[];const hash=require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update($json.raw_body).digest('hex');return [{json:{accepted:true,ignored:false,event_id:String(eventId),inbox_id:String(inboxId),thread_id:String(threadId),message_id:String(messageId),provider_timestamp:timestamp,subject:String(m.subject||''),sender,recipients:Array.isArray(recipients)?recipients:[recipients],extracted_text:text,labels:Array.isArray(m.labels)?m.labels:[],attachments,payload_hash:hash,thread_state:{thread_id:String(threadId),last_message_id:String(messageId)},next_action:'STORE_AND_TRIAGE'}}];
